purpose: Define in advance what evidence can close Policy Lab's external Gauntlet gates and prevent internal activity, traffic, or favorable reactions from being miscounted as validation.
global_non_evidence: GitHub stars, page views, clones, or social engagement
a judge saying the demo looks good
an AI model reviewing or reproducing the author's own reasoning
the public Ausgrid checkpoint without source-holder review
submission to a competition without independent evaluation

protocols.name: Independent clean-room reproduction

minimum_evidence.evaluator_relation: not an author and did not prepare the release package
minimum_evidence.starting_material: frozen public release/package and documented instructions only

protocols.pass_rule: The evaluator independently reaches the declared result and identity agreement without code changes or author intervention after the attempt begins.
protocols.publication_boundary: A failed attempt remains reportable evidence and must not be deleted from the validation ledger.

protocols.name: External-source heterogeneity

minimum_evidence.material_contrast_from_public_ausgrid: format, custodian, interval semantics, source relationship, or authentication

protocols.pass_rule: A materially different external source completes its declared intake, policy, decision, and reproduction contract without unsupported assurance promotion.
protocols.publication_boundary: Raw rows need not be published; only authorized metadata, diagnostics, aggregates, identities, and limitations may enter the public package.

protocols.name: Blind evaluator comprehension
required_questions: Does the evidence or a signature prove physical truth?
Why can the same evidence be admitted by one policy and blocked by another?
Why is an admitted quantity bounded?
What remains unproven in the demonstrated case?
protocols.pass_rule: At least 80% of scored answers across the fixed questions are correct, with the exact sample and mistakes disclosed.
protocols.publication_boundary: This measures comprehension of the presentation, not scientific validity, adoption, or product-market fit.

protocols.name: Practical workflow validation
protocols.pass_rule: At least one inspectable external workflow demonstrates a real reason to use or test the mechanism beyond competition presentation.
protocols.publication_boundary: One workflow can close the existence gate but cannot be generalized into market demand or product-market fit.
